description: This file is a test script for the lighttpd web server, specifically testing core condition matching and URL rewriting functionality. It uses the Test::More framework to validate different request and response scenarios, including configuration include files, URL rewriting, and conditional response handling.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A testing class for the lighttpd server that provides methods to start, handle HTTP requests, and stop the server during tests.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for the LightyTest class, initializes a new test instance.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server or environment supports a specific feature such as PCRE support.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process for testing.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request within the test, returning status codes to verify configuration and URL rewriting.

methods.name: stop_proc
methods.description: Stops the running lighttpd server process after testing.
